title: Stance
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter of a stance catalog entry. Validates stances/<name>.md frontmatter; the markdown body holds the stance ethos and is composed into the system prompt at runtime, before agent-specific persona text.

$schema.description: JSON Schema self-reference pointer. Optional in frontmatter.

name.description: Kebab-case unique identifier. Must match the filename stem of stances/<name>.md.

description.description: One-line description of the lens this stance applies. Read as: 'an agent in this stance looks at things by ___'.

applies_to.description: Subject classes this stance can productively engage with. 'any' is acceptable when the stance is genuinely subject-agnostic.

compatibility.description: How this stance composes with others on the same play.

conflicts_with.description: Stances that produce noise rather than signal when paired (e.g., two skeptics on the same problem). The orchestrator should warn or refuse when these co-occur in a scrimmage roster.

default_probes.description: Questions this stance asks by default. Used by plays that don't specify probes explicitly. The agent body in roster files may extend or refine these.

default_temperature.description: Recommended sampling temperature for agents in this stance. Specific agent files may override.

created.description: Date the stance was first declared (YYYY-MM-DD).
